name: 1620 Prairie Avenue — Robert Law house restored for 1904 (district draft; refined by T-1861)

function.note: The 1911 sheet draws no front building at 1620. The T-1840 census (frontage-20-006, backcast_1886) stands the Robert Law house for 1904 because Robinson 1886 plate 10 prints 1620 against a brick house on lots 13-14 and the 1904 Blue Book lists the F. VanS. Hibbard household at the address (named record pa-1620-1904-correction); residence is inferred from that listing.

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2334, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1861 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the Robinson 1886 plate 10 reading (r1886-1620-f: the outline in the plate's pixels, carried by its T-1250 fit) (r1886-1620-f), the T-1840 census (r1886-1620-f) and the T-1837 register row frontage-20-006 (Robert Law house restored for 1904); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-prairie-16-18-west-2334).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: Robinson 1886 draws the house and the T-1840 census carries it to 1904 on the 1904 Blue Book's listing at 1620. The 1911 sheet shows the frontage open, so the house was gone by then; when it was built and when it went are T-1861's to read.

position.symbolic_location: 1620 S. Prairie Avenue, parcel prairie_1620 (data/street_grid/1904.json), west side of Prairie Avenue, Prairie Avenue, 16th to 18th Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 20).
position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 32.750, v -0.250 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the plate: the plate's fit is 4.54 m RMS, the weakest of the four T-1250 fits (a photographed atlas page, rotated and curved toward the binding), plus about a pixel (0.35 m) of reading. Rotation -0.579 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.

derivation.reason: The four derivation methods re-derive from the 1835 files; this position is re-derived from the traced sheet and the 1904 parcel by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py --check instead.

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: RECONSTRUCTED: Robinson's atlas prints no storey count, and the 1911 sheet, which would, no longer draws the house. Two storeys over a raised basement is the draft's reading of the register's 'irregular earlier brick envelope' with a 'bounded roof'; T-1861 reads the 1898 numbered drawing the register names.

construction.note: Robinson 1886 colours the building pink, the plate's brick (its frame buildings are yellow); the register's 'irregular earlier brick envelope' agrees.

draft_plan.note: Rectangles fitted inside the traced parts by the rules' fit (cell 0.25 m, at most 3 a part, to 90% cover): r1886-1620-f p1 (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 96% of its fill; r1886-1620-f p1 (main, brick), rectangle 2 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 96% of its fill. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: The Robert Law house restored for 1904 (the register's 'irregular earlier brick envelope across lots 13-14, projecting bay, arched windows, stoop, bounded roof'): the plate's L read as the main body and its shallower south part, under a low hip. Its stable on the alley is the sheet's own long two-storey brick building. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 3331540667 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
